# Equivalence surcharge (SUR)

When a supply to a retailer carries the recargo de equivalencia, at which rate, and on which invoice.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/surcharge

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## SUR-001

**The surcharge rate matches the VAT rate of its line**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

A line sold to a retailer under the surcharge regime carries the surcharge rate the law pairs with that line's VAT rate, and goes under regime key 18; a line under 18 always carries a surcharge. Add it only when the buyer has told you they are under the regime.

**Why:** A surcharge that does not match the VAT rate charges the wrong tax, and AEAT does not accept the pair in the record.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; Supplies of goods to a retailer under the equivalence surcharge regime (regime key 18).

**Error codes:** [`INVALID_IVA_SURCHARGE_PAIR`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/INVALID_IVA_SURCHARGE_PAIR), [`SURCHARGE_REQUIRES_REGIME`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SURCHARGE_REQUIRES_REGIME), [`REGIME_REQUIRES_SURCHARGE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/REGIME_REQUIRES_SURCHARGE)

**Legal basis:**

- Ley 37/1992 del IVA, art. 161 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a161
- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 3.1.3.15.3 TipoRecargoEquivalencia — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf

**Incorrect:** A 10 % line with the 5.2 surcharge: the API answers INVALID_IVA_SURCHARGE_PAIR.

**Correct:** A 21 % line with its 5.2 surcharge under regime 18.

```json
{ "description": "Kitchen utensils (resale)", "quantity": 10, "unit_price": 12, "main_tax": { "type": "IVA", "percentage": 21, "regime_key": "18" }, "equivalence_surcharge_rate": 5.2 }
```

**Related:** SUR-002, TAX-003

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/equivalence-surcharge#accepted-surcharge-values · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/equivalence-surcharge#when-you-add-the-surcharge

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SUR-001.md

## SUR-002

**Supplies with the surcharge go on separate invoices**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Document the supplies that carry the equivalence surcharge on their own invoices, stating the surcharge rate and amount. BeeL. applies the surcharge line by line and does not stop you from mixing lines with and without it.

**Why:** The law requires separate invoices for these supplies; an invoice that mixes them does not meet the invoicing obligations.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; Supplies of goods on which the equivalence surcharge is charged.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 16.4 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a16

**Incorrect:** One invoice to a retailer with goods for resale under the surcharge and a repair service without it.

**Correct:** Two invoices: one for the goods with the surcharge, one for the service.

**Related:** SUR-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/equivalence-surcharge#the-surcharge-is-per-line-not-per-invoice

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SUR-002.md
